impactPage.title: Pagayo Impact Engine — Sponsor entrepreneurs, measure real outcomes
impactPage.description: Fund cohorts of founders with full Pagayo access — free for them, live dashboards for you. Same commerce stack in Nairobi and Amsterdam.

hero.sectionLabel: For organisations that fund entrepreneurship programs
hero.tagline: Every entrepreneur gets a business. Every sponsor gets proof.
hero.intro: We don't train entrepreneurs. We provision businesses. Every founder your program supports gets a full commerce stack from day one — webshop, POS, WhatsApp, payouts to their own account. You measure sales. Not attendance.

mission.headline: Funding should follow outcomes, not slide decks.
mission.intro: Most entrepreneurship programs hand out grants, training, and PDF reports. Pagayo gives sponsored founders a production-grade commerce stack — webshop, POS, WhatsApp, payouts — and gives you verifiable metrics tied to every order.

points.title: Zero platform cost for founders
points.description: Sponsored entrepreneurs get the same product European businesses pay for. No watered-down tier, no trial expiry mid-program.

points.title: Outcomes you can audit
points.description: Revenue, orders, customers, and cohort progress flow into dashboards and exportable reports — not self-reported surveys.

points.title: Built for emerging markets
points.description: Edge-first architecture, mobile-first admin, and payment rails that work where Stripe operates — including Kenya and much of Sub-Saharan Africa.

parity.headline: One platform. Two cities. No compromise.
parity.intro: Whether your cohort runs a boutique in Amsterdam or a market stall network in Nairobi, they operate on identical infrastructure.

metrics.headline: What your dashboard tracks
metrics.intro: Every sponsored account feeds aggregate metrics — anonymised at the entrepreneur level when required, drill-down when your program allows.

items.label: Time to first sale
items.description: Average days from account creation to first completed order — typically four days for new cohorts.

items.label: 12-month survival rate
items.description: Percentage of founders still transacting after the program grant period ends — the strongest indicator of sustainable impact.

items.label: Revenue earned
items.description: Gross and net sales per cohort, region, and time window.

items.label: Orders fulfilled
items.description: Completed, cancelled, and returned orders with channel breakdown.

items.label: Customers served
items.description: Unique buyers and repeat purchase rates.

items.label: Active entrepreneurs
items.description: Who is transacting, who needs support, who graduated.

items.label: Jobs supported
items.description: Optional headcount and role tags per tenant for employment programs.

items.label: Program milestones
items.description: Custom KPIs — first sale, €1k revenue, 100 orders, and more.
